statement: Anthropic is reported to have committed roughly $45 billion over six years to Nscale for compute built on NVIDIA Vera Rubin systems.
why: A single model lab committing this much money for next-generation NVIDIA systems is a large forward demand signal.

impact.mechanism: A multi-year purchase commitment to a neocloud converts into orders for NVIDIA next-generation systems and the sites to house them.

evidence.excerpt: described as a "$45 billion in AI compute" commitment over "six years"

confidence.basis: Secondary reporting sourced to unnamed sources; neither party confirmed the deal on the record.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: magnitude 2 -> 3; sources: NVIDIA Newsroom, TechCrunch
